home.aboutTagline: Stylish comfort for every day – your experts in premium footwear
home.aboutWelcomeBody: As a modern Swiss company, we are dedicated to a clear mission: bringing high-quality walking and standing comfort directly to you. As the official general distributor for internationally leading manufacturers, we bridge traditional craftsmanship, modern design and contemporary ergonomics.
home.aboutPhilosophyTitle: Our philosophy: quality you can feel
home.aboutPhilosophyBody: Much of our lives is spent on our feet. Whether in a demanding workday, at home or in leisure time – our feet deserve the best possible support. At TrendSwiss we select our collections according to the strictest criteria. We consistently rely on premium natural materials (such as fine genuine leather) and meticulous workmanship that guarantees durability and an optimal wearing experience.
home.aboutAssortmentBody: With a carefully curated and versatile range, we offer the right answer to different needs. From classic clogs for professional use in practices, pharmacies or care settings to elegant sandals and comfortable slippers for the whole family: our products combine an anatomically shaped footbed with modern design. They fit harmoniously into every situation in life and promote daily wellbeing with every step.
home.aboutPartnerBody1: TrendSwiss GmbH sees itself not only as a retailer, but as a long-term partner. Thanks to our direct connection to manufacturing facilities, we can act flexibly, ensure the highest quality standards and always offer you an attractive price-performance ratio.
home.aboutPartnerBody2: Whether you are a trade customer looking to enrich your range with our quality products or a private customer seeking the perfect companion for everyday life – the customer and first-class service are always our priority.
home.aboutWhy1Text: Carefully selected models from established international producers.
home.aboutWhy2Text: Anatomically considered fits for fatigue-free standing and walking in everyday life.
home.aboutWhy3Text: High-quality leather and breathable components for a pleasant foot climate.
home.aboutWhy4Text: Competent service, straightforward handling and genuine customer proximity.
home.aboutClosingLine: Take the path to success with us and experience comfort anew.
home.aboutFooterLine: TrendSwiss GmbH – step by step towards greater wellbeing.

leonSizeGuide.title: Size guide
leonSizeGuide.step1: Place your foot flat on a sheet of paper and mark the longest point of your toes and the back of your heel. It is best to do this standing up and wearing socks.
leonSizeGuide.step2: Measure the distance in a straight line from the longest toe to the back of your heel using a ruler or tape measure.
leonSizeGuide.step3: Use the table to find your EU size.
